p1: You've heard the legend: someone secretly living in your attic. In Los Angeles... it was true.
1913. A married woman named Dolly Oesterreich hid a young man named Otto in her attic.
By day, he crept down to clean. At night, he wrote stories up there.
When they moved to Los Angeles, Dolly made sure the new house had an attic.
Her husband was found dead. Dolly was locked inside a closet.
She said a burglar did it... and took his diamond watch.
Otto locked her in, took the watch... and climbed back into the attic.
When Dolly moved house, Otto moved with her. Into the next attic.
Eight years later, it all came out. The papers called him the Bat Man.
Convicted of manslaughter... he walked free. The time limit had run out.
Check your attic. Follow for more true stories.
